task.title: Ratify the lens→codon→binary projection

evidence.text: Released FULLY SCOPED (not a decision-defer). BUILD PLAN: (1) projection lens_codon_binary(lens_id) in portal-core/src/aspect.rs mirroring lens_orbiter_relations; struct LensCodonBinaryProjection{lens_id,source,segment:Vec<u16>,per_degree:Vec<LensCodonDegree>} in profile_projections.rs; kernel.rs wrapper kernel_bridge_m3_lens_codon_binary. (2) per degree: codon = raw_clock_degree_entry(deg).hexagram_id & 0x3F (m3_transcription_bridge.rs:332); charges{pp,nn,np,pn}+quaternion[4] REUSE bioquaternion_transcription(codon); codonUpper/Lower/class/hexagramId/lineChangeOperator(=hexagram_line_active)/tick12/exactDegree720 straight off the LUT entry. (3) element canonical: canonical_from_m3_decan_element is epi-cli-ONLY -> normalize at the epi-cli bridge layer typed_json_m3_lens_codon_binary, NOT portal-core. (4) segment for lens i (CLOCK_LENSES_16[i] slice S, sections N) = the N boundary degrees k*S; per_degree at those. (5) bridge wiring in kernel_bridge_runtime.rs: KERNEL_BRIDGE_M3_LENS_CODON_BINARY const ~:39, typed_json_m3_lens_codon_binary ~:952, dispatch arm ~:550, capability_names() ~:749, resolver ~:1490. (6) test mod in aspect.rs: for all 16 lenses/boundary degrees round-trip charges+quaternion == bioquaternion_transcription(codon), elementCanonical in 0..=5, codon fields == LUT. SPEC BUG: 'round-trip all 18 apertures' is WRONG — the code is the 16+1 law (CLOCK_LENSES_16 + Fibonacci Ground, no 17th lens); build/test to 16. 37.9 (lens_orbiter_relations) is verify-first-ready once 37.8 lands.
